metadata.description: SOW (Stay On Web): Claude Code and Codex skills that make your website findable (technical SEO, AEO, GEO) and compliant (privacy, cookies, GDPR/CCPA, payments, licenses, AI).

plugins.name: sow
plugins.description: findable: technical SEO, AEO and GEO for your codebase. Checks whether Google and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) can find, read and cite your site, and fixes what you approve. compliance: finds privacy, cookie consent, GDPR/CCPA, payments, AI disclosure and licensing gaps and builds the fixes you approve (not legal advice). No API keys.
